Statement: The system shall authenticate players with a dedicated MTGO account (username/password) created in-client or via the operator account ecosystem.
CrankMagic_Implication: Hosted accounts must map 1:1 if Premier in scope

Statement: The system shall enforce age eligibility (18+; 13–17 with parental registration) and non-transferable personal accounts.
CrankMagic_Implication: Legal wrapping required for hosted play

Statement: The system shall support Basic free tier with restricted features and one-time Full upgrade unlocking Trade/Chat/Challenge/Store.
Rationale: Funnel economics; free try-play spirit is SHOULD
CrankMagic_Implication: May differ gates; keep free try-play

Statement: The system shall reclaim Basic accounts after ~3 months inactivity, freeing username and Basic product.
The system shall apply U.S. export/embargo controls for sanctioned regions.
The system shall restrict Scheduled/Premier participation and cash/invitation prizes to allowlisted countries and 18+ where required.
The system shall bind players to EULA, ToS, Privacy Policy, arbitration/class waiver at create and material updates.
Rationale: Legal continuity; EULA_en.rtf ships in client

Statement: The system shall support tax reporting (e.g. 1099) for winnings above threshold.
The system shall process Store payments via approved processors; fees generally non-refundable except technical/fraud discretion.
The system shall treat digital cards/inventory as Digital Objects: limited license to play; no player ownership of Accounts or Digital Objects.
CrankMagic_Implication: Never market ownership; match EULA model

Statement: The system shall persist inventory (cards, tickets, PP, avatars, chests, boosters) across sessions.
Rationale: Without persistence MTGO is not MTGO

Statement: The system shall allow the same Digital Object to be assigned to multiple decks.
The system shall forfeit Digital Object use rights on account termination.
The system shall ship/update complete card data/art payload for eternal formats (Card.dll ~216MB).
The system shall sell Event Tickets as primary tradable unit for entry and peer trade.
CrankMagic_Implication: Liquidity mechanism required even if not tix

Statement: The system shall provide non-tradable Play Points usable for entry at published equivalence without mixing with tickets on same entry.
Rationale: Dual currency separates value from subsidy

Statement: The system shall provide New Player Points for onboarding/phantom events.
The system shall provide in-client Trade (binders, wish list, search, buddy trade, confirm flow, trade chat) for Full accounts.
CrankMagic_Implication: Trade/economy weak today — build or partner

Statement: The system shall provide a Store for tickets, boosters, bundles, Commander decks, redemption SKUs, account upgrade.
The system shall prohibit off-platform RMT and account sale/transfer; not recognize off-platform transfers.
The system shall prohibit gameplay bots, unattended macros, protocol emulation, unauthorized gameplay-impacting programs.
The system shall treat trading bots as not formally authorized; first-party marketplace or ban is a product decision.
Rationale: Strategic gray market; enforcement GAP vs practice

Statement: The system shall ban bribery; allow limited defined final-round prize splits without operator enforcing splits.
The system shall offer Treasure Chests or equivalent tunable prize sinks/faucets.
The system shall support Standard/Pioneer/Modern/Legacy/Vintage/Pauper with B&R sync (next day noon PT).
The system shall support Premodern and Duel Commander at least via Challenges (leagues Unverified).
The system shall support multiplayer Commander Open Play and 1v1 Commander Gauntlet.
The system shall support Momir, Cubes (Vintage Cube), Jumpstart, Pack Wars, Flashbacks, Phantom limited.
The system shall provide Constructed leagues, 2P queues, Gold SE 8-player queues, Draft/Sealed leagues and 8-man queues.
The system shall provide Open Play (Play Now/Quick Play/lobbies/Buddy Challenge).
The system shall not rely on Arena Alchemy/digital-only balance as primary competitive pool.
The system shall remove mid-league illegal decks after B&R and return entry.
The system shall expose Play lobby surface distinct from Duel and Draft (PlayScene).
The system shall provide collection+deck editor with filters, search, versions, image/table views, qty incl. zero.
The system shall support text/.dek import/export, clipboard import, server auto-save.
The system shall enforce sideboard, Companion-in-sideboard, Commander color identity.
The system shall mark illegal/missing cards and allow Update with collection versions.
The system shall provide mana curve, sample hands, deck settings.
The system shall enforce Basic deck slot limits (20); Full limits Unverified.
The system shall allow saving draft logs to disk.
The system shall match leagues on course score, wait time, rematch bias (not Elo/trophies/outside record).
The system shall fire on-demand queues at minimum player thresholds (2 or 8 typical).
The system shall support scheduled Swiss+Top8 and fixed-round events with standings/tiebreakers.
The system shall progress Premier via QP/Leaderboard Points rather than public global Elo.
The system shall support Commander Brackets with path to programmatic validation.
The system shall digitally adjudicate under Comprehensive Rules (priority, stack, layers, replacement effects).
CrankMagic_Implication: Forge-local = core asset; CR test harness

Statement: The system shall provide phase/step stops, lockable Phase Bar, Yield Until Here, defaults.
The system shall support priority hold and deep shortcut/auto-yield system (mostly rebindable).
The system shall run per-player chess clock while holding priority; 0 = loss; round caps by event.
The system shall announce disconnect; grace without freezing clock; reconnect does not restore lost time.
The system shall allow operator adjudication of any match/event result.
The system shall provide duel audio feedback for combat/damage/destroy/life/PW/priority/win-lose etc.
The system shall provide buddies, challenge, trade, chat for Full accounts.
The system shall support ignore/block.
The system shall provide monitored room/game chat; Basic cannot chat.
The system shall allow casual spectate when host permits; competitive generally not live-spectatable (secondary).
The system shall provide match replay (current on/off Unverified).
The system shall embed Player Code of Conduct and Game Guide in-client.
The system shall operate seasonal QP path through Challenges/Qualifiers/Showcase to Champions Showcase and Worlds invites.
CrankMagic_Implication: Major build if in deal scope

Statement: The system shall serve as digital qualifying path to tabletop Regional Championships.
The system shall prohibit multi-accounting in Showcase/Qualifiers; one Scheduled entry per person; ban account sharing.
The system shall provide DEC chat/admin tooling for covered events.
The system shall support Showcase streaming requirements/constraints for invitees.
Exact QP thresholds, prize pools, Gold SE vs Prelim scheduling shall be tunable.
The system shall offer Physical Redemption (or explicit successor value-bridge) for complete main-sets under published conditions.
Rationale: Trust bridge; EULA allows cancel but sunset without bridge is crisis

Statement: The system shall allow non-redeemable SKU designation with clear communication.
The system shall reflect foil redemption discontinued posture (Bloomburrow+).
The system shall make Store stock authoritative when schedule shows availability but stock exhausted.
The system shall provide help submission, bug feedback, Game Support for redemption.
The system shall reimburse/nullify vendor-side event bugs per policy; not player ISP/ToS/unverifiable.
The system shall top up Challenge min-prize shortfalls in PP within SLA.
The system shall provide in-client Report Issue path.
The system shall provide Admin scene for contested events/account actions.
The system shall publish and meet Windows min/rec hardware specs.
The system shall keep duel input-to-feedback latency acceptable for competitive play under recommended specs.
The system shall manage large card payload updates without routinely corrupting installs.
Rationale: Card.dll scale; community pain / modernity GAP

Statement: The system shall support reconnect within grace without corrupting match state.
The system shall auto-patch to a consistent dependency set.
The system shall maintain ClickOnce/installer dependency integrity (all XAML-referenced assemblies present or fail closed with repair).
Store and redemption workflows shall be idempotent under retry.
The system shall deter cheats/hacks/mods/gameplay bots/collusion/defect exploits with suspension and Digital Object forfeit.
The client may collect hardware/profile/network signals and monitor unauthorized concurrent programs as disclosed.
The system shall protect credentials and session tokens in transit and at rest.
The system shall enforce age gates, parental consent, privacy, export controls, prize geofencing.
The system shall retain/present EULA, Prize Eligibility, Player Rewards Eligibility, Code of Conduct.
The system shall support tax info collection for prize winners as required.
The system shall provide basic visual aids (card zoom, card size).
The system shall pursue WCAG screen reader and colorblind support.
Rationale: WCAG/screen reader not first-class on MTGO; a11y GAP / CrankMagic differentiation

Statement: The system shall ship Windows desktop client with published specs until multi-platform parity.
Mac/Linux/mobile/cloud-stream clients.
Client tech may remain C#/WPF/XAML/ClickOnce or move to successor.
Native interop (x64/x86 SQLite.Interop, p4bridge) shall be packaged as required.
The client shall write operational logs for support triage.
The operator shall have telemetry for outcomes, disconnects, trade anomalies, Premier integrity.
The system shall scale matchmaking/duel for Premier/set-release peaks without integrity loss.
Trade and Store shall remain available during peak liquidity.
The system shall ship English legal/help resources at minimum.
Additional UI languages.
Timer and disconnect rules shall not be trivially abusable.
League matchmaking shall prefer course-score pairing over smurf-friendly open Elo.
Shuffles/packs randomization shall be cryptographically adequate.
The system shall provide event-driven audio pack (startup, tournament/game, draft, timers, card verbs, duel verbs, product, UI chrome).
Audio shall be user-toggleable/volume-scoped in Settings.
